plugins.name: bilibili-persona
plugins.description: Turn a bilibili course series into a knowledge base, an optional teacher persona skill, and (auto mode) an Obsidian LLM Wiki ingestion: transcribe locally, distill knowledge, write sources/concepts/entities into the vault.
